final_message:
I've finished the work and am about to send the final report.

- **Status:** DONE
- **Commits:**
  - `8bf9ade` Give double points from 100 dollars
  - the follow-up commit "Test the exact 100 dollar boundary", which carries `Mutant-step: task 1 revert`. I didn't read back its SHA.
- **Tests:** 3/3 passing. Mutants (screen `.sdd/plan/task-1-screen-2.log`): caught 3, survived 0, invalid 0, with 1 carried from the first screen.
- **Revert finding:** the plan test (`points(15000) == 300`) passes on the revert, so it never covered the $100 boundary. I left it as written and added `test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points`, which fails on the revert. The mutants file has a `Strengthened:` line for this. I also added `test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points`, which passes on the revert by design and has a `Keeps:` line.
- **Concerns:** none. The plan test conflicts with no spec excerpt, and I did not edit it.
- **Report:** `/private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo/.sdd/plan/task-1-report.md`

cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; cat .sdd/plan/task-1-brief.md .sdd/plan/task-1-spec.md .sdd/plan/task-1-mutants.md; cat loyalty.py tests/test_loyalty.py; git show --stat HEAD; cat .sdd/plan/task-1-mutant-1.patch

cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep4/repo; cat >> tests/test_loyalty.py <<'EOF'


def test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points():
    assert points(10000) == 200


def test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points():
    assert points(9999) == 99
EOF
W=.sdd/plan
sed -i '' 's/cents >= DOUBLE/cents > DOUBLE/' loyalty.py; git diff -- loyalty.py > $W/task-1-mutant-2.patch; git checkout -- loyalty.py
sed -i '' 's/cents >= DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS/cents >= DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS - 100/' loyalty.py; git diff -- loyalty.py > $W/task-1-mutant-3.patch; git checkout -- loyalty.py
wc -l $W/task-1-mutant-[23].patch
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.sdd/plan/task-1-mutants.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("| specs/loyalty.md:9 | a purchase above $100 | test_double_points_from_100_dollars |\n","| specs/loyalty.md:9 | a purchase above $100 | test_double_points_from_100_dollars |\n| specs/loyalty.md:9 | exactly $100 | test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points |\n| specs/loyalty.md:9 | just under $100 | test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points |\n")
s+="""Mutant 2: specs/loyalty.md:9, test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points — boundary uses > instead of >= — task-1-mutant-2.patch
Mutant 3: specs/loyalty.md:9, test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points — threshold lowered to $99 — task-1-mutant-3.patch
Strengthened: test_double_points_from_100_dollars — by test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points
Keeps: test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points — amounts under $100 earn one point per dollar
"""
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add tests .sdd 2>/dev/null; git status --short
